title: Poiana Rotunda
description:
'Poiana Rotunda – Echoes from the Hoia Baciu Forest' The work captures the legendary mystery of the Hoia Baciu Forest in the liminal moment of dusk,
when reality begins to unravel into the unknown.
The color palette—dominated by violet, blue, green, and pink 
creates a dreamlike, almost spectral atmosphere, where light ceases to be merely a natural phenomenon and 
becomes emotion itself.
At the center of the composition, the round glade becomes a space suspended between worlds.
Rings of mist slowly dissolve into the air, like ephemeral traces of an invisible presence.
They belong neither to nature nor to humankind—they seem to be the breath of a mysterious entity,
a sign of the paranormal aura that makes this forest a place steeped in myth.
The work explores the boundary between beauty and unease,
between dream and legend, inviting the viewer to step into the unknown and feel the vibration of a hidden reality.
